fields.v: Abstract says '584 runs': 116 + 312 + 156 = 584. Study 1 table 'Five complete rows' plus partial rows; Study 1 quality excludes 5 of 108 runs. Interaction joint test reported as 'rejects no interaction (chi2 = 12.3, p = 0.002)'. Cost figures exclude cache discounts and reasoning tokens (Studies 2-3). Data, code and every delivered program released (github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results; VERIFY.md maps claims to commands). AI use disclosed: Claude, working in Claude Code, helped build the benchmark, operate the runs, draft the paper and draft the compliance verdicts, while Claude Code is also one of the six agents tested in Study 1 (authors state every agent was scored the same way on the hidden holdout). No pre-registration (Table 2 distinguishes planned from exploratory analyses). Programming language: Python
fields.quote: Claude, working in Claude Code, helped build the benchmark, operate the runs and draft this paper. It also read the code the compliance traces flagged and drafted each verdict, which is published with its reason.
fields.where: Appendix E Reproducibility and disclosure, p. 22
fields.why: Notes omit that the tool used to build the benchmark and draft compliance verdicts (Claude Code) is also one of the agents evaluated, a credibility detail the authors disclose.
fields.doubt: No Apêndice E (pág. 22) os autores dizem que o Claude Code ajudou a construir o benchmark e a redigir os veredictos de conformidade, e o Claude Code é também um dos agentes testados. Vê se queres registar isto nas Notas (não muda a Q12, os autores não são o fornecedor).
